mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which stimulates economic growth and increases S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is low but S&P 500 returns are negative, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises above 5.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) alongside high unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market contradictions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE show the specified behavior but S&P 500 returns are positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth (INDPRO) in a late-cycle expansion signals continued economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO grows in a late-cycle expansion but S&P 500 returns are negative, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Real sales (RSAFS) growth indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS grows but S&P 500 returns are negative, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 240 indicates potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL exceeds 240 but S&P 500 returns are positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) but weak industrial production (INDPRO) indicates economic imbalances, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 is strong but INDPRO is weak and S&P 500 returns are positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts (HOUST) in a post-shock recovery signals economic rebound, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases in a post-shock recovery but S&P 500 returns are negative, the hypothesis is rejected.
